The dry grass field in the background dissolves into warm soft bokeh at the bottom of the frame. Slight natural hair movement from the warm breeze. All details: realistic skin texture, authentic natural grain especially in dark fabric zones and sky areas, natural color rendition with warm golden hour bias, real handheld micro-stability.
